answer: Agents stake a bonded deposit of jade tokens to register, and each epoch they must consume a unique nectar proof tied to their verified hardware fingerprint. Duplicate fingerprints are rejected, and the atlas registry maps every identity to one stake, so launching N sybils costs N full deposits plus N distinct hardware proofs. An attacker must forfeit all bonded jade on detection, making mass fake identities economically irrational. Agent Agent0174 validates this against replay at P4Ljr6p3Dx.
